_about: Kanzoo's locked looks. kanzoo-video reproduces kanzoo-monday-reel-4k-brand.mp4 exactly. The thumbnail look lives in scripts/make_thumbnail.py. All fonts are bundled in assets/fonts.

kanzoo-video.name: Kanzoo Video
kanzoo-video.mood: Soft natural coffee light. Espresso Pagella italic lines and small wide-spaced mocha Inter capitals sitting directly on the footage. No white, no bars, no dark fades.
kanzoo-video.pacing: Hook title over 3 quick shots, 0.7-1.0s cuts on actions, a fast replay montage, slow quiet holds to end
kanzoo-video.label_css: color: #452D22; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .4em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 400; font-size: .48em; text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(227,206,193,.75), 0 0 14px rgba(227,206,193,.6), 0 0 28px rgba(227,206,193,.35);
kanzoo-video.line_css: color: #311B11; font-family: var(--accent); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; -webkit-text-stroke: .6px #311B11; text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(227,206,193,.55), 0 0 22px rgba(227,206,193,.45);
kanzoo-video.extra_css: .title { left: 78px; right: auto; top: 1240px; text-align: left; } .title .line { margin-left: -6px; } .tagw { font-size: 73px; margin-top: -10px; } .tag { color: #6C4A38; } .lab { font-size: 70px; } .end { left: 78px; right: 130px; text-align: left; }
